purpose: Generates a QR payment scheme participant user-acceptance test pack from a declared participant list (pseudonymous codes and issuer/acquirer/wallet/aggregator roles) and a scheme profile (generic, fjqr, pix_brcode). The interoperability matrix covers every ordered presenter/payer pair whose roles can transact, at most N x (N-1), with self-pairs and role-impossible pairs excluded and counted with reasons. Each transactable pair gets positive static and dynamic cases and negative cases described as mutations only (bad CRC including the excluded-6304 generator bug, wrong profile-pinned currency, missing merchant account template, malformed tag 62, static payload carrying an amount where the profile forbids it), plus optional reversal, refund, dispute and payee-name outcome cases, phased domestic first and then cross-border when foreign link profiles are declared. Case ids are content-derived and stable, counts are per phase and kind, and per-phase exit criteria are emitted. Scope limits: no payloads with real participant, merchant or account data are accepted or emitted; negative cases are described as mutations, never emitted as live QR strings; no network, no signature verification, no endorsement by EMVCo, any central bank or the World Bank is implied.
